findings.title: Recovery codes remain reusable in user storage
findings.body: This validator only checks whether the submitted code appears in the stored list; it never removes or marks the matched code as used. Unlike the local recovery-code provider, this user-storage implementation therefore accepts the same recovery code on every login, defeating the one-time-use security guarantee. Consume the matched code and persist the updated list, and cover reuse with a test.
